title: Dispatcher
summary:
Our client is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented dispatcher to join their outbound team based in Eagle Farm. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in your work, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Highlights:
Temp to perm role with a competitive hourly rate of $32.76+ Overtime
Opportunity to work for a global transportation and logistics company
Chance to develop valuable skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment
Work with a great tight knit team!
Preferred Requirements:
Strong attention to detail to ensure orders are labelled and dispatched in a timely manner.
Process Dispatch Documents accordingly
Ability to work efficiently and effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
Excellent communication skills to collaborate with team members
Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and technologies
Preferred Qualifications:
Previous experience in a similar dispatch or warehouse logistic roles
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team
Own transportation (2k walk from Kingsford Smith Drive)
LO/LF Licence preferred not essential

title: Forklift Operator/ Pick Pack
summary:

Day Shift | Start ASAP | Ongoing Work

Join a recognised company that’s growing like crazy! We’re on the lookout for skilled Counter balance Forklift Operators to jump into an awesome team based in Woodridge.

 Shift: Monday to Friday, 8:30am – 5:00pm
 $37.00 per hour

- Current Forklift Licence
- At least 12 months' forklift experience 
- Warehousing and pick packing experience
- Physically fit - The goods can vary in weight 
- A good team vibe – you'll be working closely with others

✅ What You’ll Be Doing:
- Driving counter balance
- Picking and packing orders
- Loading/Unloading 
- Being part of a tight-knit AMAZING crew

✅ Perks of the Job:
- $37.00 rate
- Easy location in Southside with free onsite parking
- Great team with good laughs, straightforward picking process
- Casual to perm opportunities for the right candidate
- In-house promotions - Our client will always look to promote within before  outsourcing. This allows individuals to grow and thrive.
